world.title: Brackwater QA Campaign
world.description: Disposable campaign fixture for Solo Adventure Mode manual QA on staging.

entities.title: Mara
entities.summary: A river courier who knows the backwaters and ferries parcels between fogbound landings.

entities.title: Brackwater Quay
entities.summary: A timber river landing lined with tarred pilings, fishmonger stalls, and a stone customs house.

content.body: GM-SECRET-QUAY: Smugglers move unmarked crates through the flooded culvert beneath Pier 4 at low tide.

entities.title: Harbourmaster Venn
entities.summary: A meticulous dock official who logs every barge and collects quay tolls in a battered ledger.

content.body: GM-SECRET-VENN: Venn is quietly blackmailed by the River Guild to look the other way on midnight landings.

entities.title: Old Bell Tower
entities.summary: A moss-covered stone watchtower overlooking the bend above the town, its iron gate chained shut.

content.body: GM-SECRET-TOWER: A waterproof brass tube with forged toll seals is hidden inside the cracked bronze bell.

entities.title: Charter of the High Tides
entities.summary: A future harbour compact scheduled to redraw toll rights along the estuary.

content.body: GM-SECRET-FUTURE: The charter has not yet been signed and must not be referenced as past or present fact.

entities.title: The Great Silt Flood
entities.summary: An old river surge that buried the lower stone wharves decades ago.
